_notes: The whole plane is mounted ONLY when JWT_PLATFORM_SECRET (>=32 chars) is set. Unset => every /v1/platform/* route 404s. That is the first thing to check before filing an admin bug.
Platform tokens are signed with a different secret and carry aud=platform, type=access. A merchant token must never satisfy a platform route, and vice versa — test both directions.
super_admin and admin cannot log in on a password alone: they must enrol TOTP first. support and read_only log in without MFA.
TOTP enrolment needs PLATFORM_ENCRYPTION_KEY (64 hex chars) — the secret is stored AES-256-GCM encrypted.
Every state-changing body requires reason: 10-500 characters. A shorter reason is a 400.
The account is re-read from the DB on every request: deactivating a platform user invalidates their live access token immediately, not at expiry.

Permissions: read_only = tenants:read, audit:read, analytics:read, billing:read. support adds the six support:* permissions. admin adds tenants:create/suspend/change_plan and platform_users:read. super_admin adds tenants:delete, tenants:override_features, platform_users:manage, billing:refund.
